observation: A direction preset could show an incomplete model when source-view eligibility was reused as geometry visibility; switching to a canonical view could also change framing, and a damaged portable stylesheet could look like missing components.
cause: Camera representation, source annotation eligibility, fit behavior and delivered runtime styling were not treated as separate verification concerns.
proposed_rule: Separate complete-model geometry visibility from source-view annotation eligibility. Direction changes preserve the current frame scale; Fit is explicit. Validate the actual portable stylesheet and inspect one distinctive affected view before full publication, because runtime presentation failures can masquerade as geometry loss.
limits: The rule is reusable; A202 IDs, coordinates and source mappings remain project-local. Browser emulation is not physical-phone testing, and this does not certify fabrication accuracy or customer acceptance.
